## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

List the exact tests and checks that were run.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to one ecosystem where practical.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation reflects public API, configuration, or compatibility changes.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, certificates, account identifiers, or production data are included.
- [ ] Each commit includes a Developer Certificate of Origin `Signed-off-by` line.
- [ ] I can explain and support every submitted change.
- [ ] I disclosed substantial AI assistance below, or it was not used.

## AI assistance

State the tools used and which parts of the change they materially assisted, or write `None`.
